note: Dispositions for every phrase tools/check-retired-content.py derives from a retired or unobtainable def label. The phrases are DERIVED, never listed here by hand; what lives here is the one judgement that cannot be derived - whether the CONCEPT survived the item. 'stale' means no player-facing string may say it. 'live' means the item went but the thing it named is still real. A new retirement fails the check until its words are dispositioned.

climate unit.why: RR_SiteClimateUnit was retired; a coordinate uses Core climate equipment.

evidence case.why: same item, and the phrase strings actually used - 'physical evidence case', 'expedition evidence case'.

field recorder.why: superseded 0.12.24-dev. The def stays loadable so old saves open, and is untradeable, unbuilt and ungranted - so nothing should tell a player to use one. Crews write into the record book they carry.

liminal climate unit.why: same def. Its keyed label survived the def by several checkpoints, referenced by nothing.

machine gate.why: retired 0.9.0-dev when a gate became a door and nothing else. The vocabulary is 'gate'; only the RR_AssembleMachineGate recipe still carries the old word in its defName.

return beacon.why: retired 0.9.9-dev. The gate's address book and the saved return threshold are the route authority, so the item had no job left.

route recording.why: REVIVED 0.13.0-dev on the owner's full reversal of the existing-content-only direction. RR_RouteRecording ships as the company route recording, a Book the company issues and a crew writes in the field. It was never removed from the evidence pipeline: CompRouteEvidence accepted this exact defName throughout as a 0.2.0 migration path, and that test is IsCompanyCarrier now because 'legacy' stopped being true. Core's TextBook is still accepted beside it, so counting the kit is plural and issuing one is singular.

sealed evidence case.why: retired 0.10.9-dev. Custody completes at a Shelf designated as the records archive, which is a PLACE rather than an item - so rewording is not enough, the instruction changes.

survey tag.why: retired 0.10.7-dev. Markers are Core glow pods now, and they are still NUMBERED - say 'numbered marker', not 'numbered tag'.

survey tags.why: same item, and the six-per-crew requirement went with it because the owner's direction was not to limit the amount.
